{
  "name": "job_search",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "A job search automator using Cypress",
  "main": "index.js",
  "author": "mattpocock",
  "license": "ISC",
  "scripts": {
    "watch": "webpack --mode development --watch",
    "build": "webpack --mode production",
    "start": "webpack-dev-server",
    "serve": "json-server --watch db.json",
    "test": "jest --watch"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "json-server": "^0.13.0",
    "moment": "^2.22.1",
    "prop-types": "^15.6.1",
    "react": "^16.3.2",
    "react-dom": "^16.3.2"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "babel-core": "^6.26.3",
    "babel-jest": "^22.4.3",
    "babel-loader": "^7.1.4",
    "babel-preset-env": "^1.6.1",
    "babel-preset-react": "^6.24.1",
    "chai": "^4.1.2",
    "css-loader": "^0.28.11",
    "enzyme": "^3.3.0",
    "enzyme-adapter-react-16": "^1.1.1",
    "eslint": "^4.19.1",
    "eslint-config-airbnb": "^16.1.0",
    "eslint-plugin-import": "^2.11.0",
    "eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y": "^6.0.3",
    "eslint-plugin-react": "^7.7.0",
    "identity-obj-proxy": "^3.0.0",
    "jest": "^22.4.3",
    "node-sass": "^4.9.0",
    "regenerator-runtime": "^0.11.1",
    "sass-loader": "^7.0.1",
    "style-loader": "^0.21.0",
    "webpack": "^4.7.0",
    "webpack-cli": "^2.1.2",
    "webpack-dev-server": "^3.1.4"
  },
  "jest": {
    "setupTestFrameworkScriptFile": "./setUpTests.js",
    "moduleNameMapper": {
      "\\.(css|less|scss|sass)$": "identity-obj-proxy"
    },
    "coveragePathIgnorePatterns": [
      "/node_modules/"
    ]
  }
}

$ npm i
$ npm run serve

In a separate window,
    $ npm run start

Download Cypress, and run cw_jobs.spec.js

Go to db.json and watch the data flow in.

Ideas for the future:
    A sortable table view for the json data
    Graphs over time
    Adding many more websites
